rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: In People's Democracy of 17 April 2005 Harkishan Singh Surjeet writes that he had asked the Central Committee to relieve him of responsibilities discharged 'first as a Polit Bureau member since 1953 and then as the general secretary since 1992'.

locator.item: section 'Here Is My Pledge!', first paragraph

rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: In the same article Surjeet writes that the Central Committee had 'half met my request': 'While Comrade Prakash Karat has taken up the mantle as the new general secretary, I was mandated to continue in the Polit Bureau'.

locator.item: section 'Here Is My Pledge!', third paragraph (handover statement)
